# Imbalance as a relatum

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> With the imbalance counted, every flow balances; balance is exactly the added relatum idle, and the two representations are equivalent step by step.

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Across a step, a condition's level changes by what the flow gives and takes exactly where the flow balances there. Wherever it does not, the difference is counted as the exchange of one more relatum, none: it gives each condition what its level rose beyond the flow's net exchange, and takes what its level fell beyond it (Flow.withImbalance, Flow.withImbalance_given, Flow.withImbalance_taken); the web reads it as the refinement of rest-with-refinement-counted is read, never active and requiring nothing (Web.withRefinement). Then the extended flow balances at every step and condition (Flow.withImbalance_balances), and on every family (Flow.withImbalance_balancesOn). The flow balances on a family across a step exactly where the added relatum neither gives nor takes on its members there (Flow.balancesOn_iff_idle), and everywhere exactly where it is idle everywhere (Flow.balances_iff_idle). The two representations are equivalent step by step: at a step and condition, in the extended flow only active relata give exactly where only active relata give in the flow and the level does not rise beyond the flow's net exchange (Flow.withImbalance_acting_at_iff), and only active relata take, and only what they draw on, exactly where they do so in the flow and the level does not fall beyond it (Flow.withImbalance_taking_at_iff); so on a family across a step both hold of the extended flow exactly where both hold of the flow and it balances there (Flow.withImbalance_acting_taking_on_iff), the forms over every step and condition being corollaries (Flow.withImbalance_acting_iff, Flow.withImbalance_taking_iff, Flow.withImbalance_acting_taking_iff). Truncated subtraction loses nothing: giving and taking each take one side of the difference, the other being zero (sub_eq_zero_of_le, le_of_sub_eq_zero). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

Canonical source: [Imbalance.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Imbalance.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Any flow and web; the added relatum is never active and requires nothing.
- Discrete steps; natural-number levels.

Ren, 11 October 2026: “please”, to the AI's suggestion that counting an imbalance as a relatum first be proved as a representation equivalent to the current one, adoption staying with Ren (the re-founding of the zero-premise plan, section 1.4); Ren adopted it on 14 October 2026. The AI's reading: with the imbalance counted, balance is a property of the representation, and what it said of a world is said instead by the inactivity of one relatum. The laws of the core keep Flow.BalancesOn as a local condition.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): the 15 theorems of Becoming.Imbalance all have empty axiom reports; the same receipt covers the package's 75 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 4518 theorems/6370 declaration audits, and 22 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261013T095049.338744Z passed. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §85 of the integration note; not yet independently reviewed.

This is an equivalence of representations, which makes the adoption lossless: the laws of the core keep balance as a local condition; the equivalence says neither which reading is better nor where a world balances; stated for discrete steps and natural-number amounts; the readings are the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation; not yet independently reviewed.

- The unbalanced world, the sides of Shuttle with no flow, meets every premise but balance (World.unbalanced_but): balance is a condition a world can fail while meeting the others. Counting the imbalance does not remove the condition but moves it: a flow balances on a family across a step exactly where the added relatum is idle there (Flow.balancesOn_iff_idle), and the extended flow meets the activity premises there exactly where the flow meets them and balances there (Flow.withImbalance_acting_taking_on_iff). Adopted, the condition stays a state of a part: whether the rest is idle (World.withRest_closed_iff).
